lines: // Using a lodestone with an empty main hand gives a compass instead.

meta.notes: A TypeScript script, stored one line per entry. msm.events.on registers a handler for the block.interact event, which runs whenever a player uses a block. The handler returns early unless the block is a lodestone used with an empty main hand; otherwise e.cancel() stops the normal use, e.player.give hands over a compass and a sound plays at the block. The Script Studio checks the code against the msm-runtime typings as you type. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the Java project export leaves them out.
